title: codemap inconsistencies report v1
description: The JSON report emitted by codemap inconsistencies --json: where the compiled knowledge disagrees with itself or the working tree. An empty report is evidence of internal coherence, not correctness. Hard-failure envelopes are outside this schema.

dangling_annotations.description: Annotations whose target no longer matches an indexed symbol. Repair: annotate --retarget <id> <new-target> or annotations --rm <id>.

name_call_edges_on_resolved_files.description: Precise-resolved files that still emit name-based candidate call edges — the coverage row and the edge set contradict each other. Repair: re-run the precise pass.

coverage_without_nodes.description: Call-graph coverage recorded for files that no longer have indexed nodes. Repair: reindex.

stale.description: True when the index has drifted from the working tree; every other claim in the report is provisional until reindexing.
